metadata.question: Were the agricultural fields between the Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals in Ukraine browner on June 18, 2023 than on May 17, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for May 17, 2023 and June 18, 2023 over a polygon approximating the agricultural area between the Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals near Nova Kakhovka, Ukraine. If no images or no valid pixels, fallback to Landsat 8/9 SR (C2 L2). Try date windows of 0, 3, and 7 days centered on the target date.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds (QA60 for Sentinel-2; QA_PIXEL bits for Landsat 8/9). Compute NDVI and summarize with mean NDVI and valid pixel count. Report mean cloudiness from collection properties for validation.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty for one or both dates after all attempts → C1.
- If images exist but valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either date → C2.
- If NDVI is null/NaN or outside [-1,1] for either date → C3.
- Otherwise, compare mean NDVI: lower NDVI on 2023-06-18 means “browner” → A: Yes; else B: No.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to promisify ee.evaluate
  const ev = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject));
  const fmt = (v, d=3) => (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v)) ? 'NA' : Number(v).toFixed(d);

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (Approx. area between Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals)
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [33.17, 46.87],
    [34.20, 46.95],
    [34.05, 46.26],
    [33.25, 46.25],
    [33.17, 46.87]
  ]);
  const dateA = '2023-05-17';
  const dateB = '2023-06-18';

  // Cloud masking and NDVI for Sentinel-2
  function maskS2(image) {
    const qa = image.select('QA60');
    const cloudBitMask = ee.Number(2).pow(10).int();
    const cirrusBitMask = ee.Number(2).pow(11).int();
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
    const scaled = image.updateMask(mask).divide(10000);
    const red = scaled.select('B4');
    const nir = scaled.select('B8');
    const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('ndvi');
    return ndvi.copyProperties(image, ['CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE']);
  }

  // Cloud masking and NDVI for Landsat 8/9 L2
  function maskL89(image) {
    const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
    const mask = cloud.or(shadow).or(cirrus).not();
    const refl = image.updateMask(mask).select(['SR_B4','SR_B5']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).rename(['red','nir']);
    const ndvi = refl.select('nir').subtract(refl.select('red')).divide(refl.select('nir').add(refl.select('red'))).rename('ndvi');
    return ndvi.copyProperties(image, ['CLOUD_COVER']);
  }

  function windowDates(dateStr, days) {
    const d = ee.Date(dateStr);
    return {
      start: d.advance(-days, 'day'),
      end: d.advance(days + 1, 'day')
    };
  }

  async function getStatsForDate(dateStr) {
    // Try Sentinel-2 windows first
    const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED').filterBounds(geom).filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    const s2Windows = [0, 3, 7];
    let hadImages = false;
    for (const w of s2Windows) {
      const {start, end} = windowDates(dateStr, w);
      const col = s2.filterDate(start, end);
      const size = await ev(col.size());
      if (size > 0) {
        hadImages = true;
        const ndviCol = col.map(maskS2);
        const mosaic = ndviCol.median();
        const stats = ee.Dictionary(mosaic.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: 3000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }));
        const ndviMean = await ev(stats.get('ndvi_mean'));
        const ndviCount = await ev(stats.get('ndvi_count'));
        if (ndviCount && ndviCount > 0) {
          const cloudMean = await ev(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'));
          return {label: dateStr, dataset: 'S2', winDays: w, imgCount: size, cloudMean: cloudMean, validPx: ndviCount, meanNDVI: ndviMean};
        }
      }
    }
    // Fallback: Landsat 8/9 L2
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom);
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom);
    const lcolBase = l8.merge(l9);
    const lWindows = [3, 7, 10];
    let lHadImages = hadImages; // track any images seen so far
    for (const w of lWindows) {
      const {start, end} = windowDates(dateStr, w);
      const col = lcolBase.filterDate(start, end);
      const size = await ev(col.size());
      if (size > 0) {
        lHadImages = true;
        const ndviCol = col.map(maskL89);
        const mosaic = ndviCol.median();
        const stats = ee.Dictionary(mosaic.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: 3000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }));
        const ndviMean = await ev(stats.get('ndvi_mean'));
        const ndviCount = await ev(stats.get('ndvi_count'));
        if (ndviCount && ndviCount > 0) {
          const cloudMean = await ev(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER'));
          return {label: dateStr, dataset: 'L8/9', winDays: w, imgCount: size, cloudMean: cloudMean, validPx: ndviCount, meanNDVI: ndviMean};
        }
      }
    }
    // No valid pixels or no images
    if (!lHadImages) {
      return {label: dateStr, emptyCollection: true};
    } else {
      return {label: dateStr, noValidPixels: true};
    }
  }

  try {
    const sA = await getStatsForDate(dateA);
    const sB = await getStatsForDate(dateB);

    // Print concise evidence lines (<=20 lines total)
    if (sA.emptyCollection) {
      console.log(`May17: No images found (all attempts).`);
    } else if (sA.noValidPixels) {
      console.log(`May17: Images found but 0 valid pixels after masking.`);
    } else {
      console.log(`May17: ${sA.dataset} imgs=${sA.imgCount} win=${sA.winDays}d cloud%=${fmt(sA.cloudMean,1)} validPx=${sA.validPx} NDVI=${fmt(sA.meanNDVI,3)}`);
    }

    if (sB.emptyCollection) {
      console.log(`Jun18: No images found (all attempts).`);
    } else if (sB.noValidPixels) {
      console.log(`Jun18: Images found but 0 valid pixels after masking.`);
    } else {
      console.log(`Jun18: ${sB.dataset} imgs=${sB.imgCount} win=${sB.winDays}d cloud%=${fmt(sB.cloudMean,1)} validPx=${sB.validPx} NDVI=${fmt(sB.meanNDVI,3)}`);
    }

    // Final decision logic
    if (sA.emptyCollection || sB.emptyCollection) {
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (sA.noValidPixels || sB.noValidPixels) {
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const ndviA = sA.meanNDVI;
    const ndviB = sB.meanNDVI;

    const invalidA = (ndviA === null || ndviA === undefined || isNaN(ndviA) || ndviA < -1 || ndviA > 1);
    const invalidB = (ndviB === null || ndviB === undefined || isNaN(ndviB) || ndviB < -1 || ndviB > 1);
    if (invalidA || invalidB) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Browner = lower NDVI
    const browner = ndviB < ndviA;
    console.log(`ΔNDVI (Jun18 - May17) = ${fmt(ndviB - ndviA,3)}`);
    if (browner) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
